column3: to the wearer of a lotus garland
by five begun: woman and man
throwing of the five sense objects
to the wearer of lotus garland
two embracing, lovely with ointment of mud
women applying mud ointment, mind churned by touching him
went to the forest with five loads
of the five or seven or ten hundred thousand heads
by silk bands, clothes, rays of jewels
in the form of a stake
of those who think themselves learned
on the back of the Lord of birds
of the Lord of the king of birds
falls like a blind following the blind
in falling, stumbling and so on
to the falling, by the contempt of the worthy
by husbands, demons, with marks of kings
having heard the husband had come
the lord: Agnidhra followers, Idhmajihva, Yajnabahu
husband by samadhi of the Self
lord and goal of Andhakas, Vrishnis, Satvatas
husband, sons, family, brothers and kin
husband, sons, family, brothers, kin: having transgressed
husbands, they truly obtained their servitude
with foot soldiers, horses, chariots, elephants
crowded with foot soldiers and horses
saluted the wives, came to the abode
by the wife adorned with flames
by your wife, the great consecration at the sacrifice
by your wife, the great consecration at the sacrifice, praiseworthy beautiful braid
your wife's great consecration at the sacrifice
wife with joy and great haste
the wife distressed by separation from children
to the husband of such a form situated
with leaves, flowers, fruits, shade, roots, bark, wood
by wings of the Lord of birds (Garuda)
uttered by the wings of Garuda
with a beauty like wandering bees by the wings of Garuda
free of leaves and so on
in the form of a path
the two feet as the abode of swans
wishing to follow the two feet
in the form of the dust of the feet
of the dust of the feet
ground by foot-blows and chariot wheels
from the battle ground ground by foot-blows and chariot wheels, intense
foot soldiers with arms, thighs, necks cut
of the foot soldier, the Lord
of one delighted by remembering the feet
steps by the eye of the Self
favoured by a trace of the grace of the two lotus feet
O friend of the afflicted, lotus feet remove fear of worldly existence of those who attained
not smelling the honey of the foot-lotus
in the position, tormented by the inner fire
by steps following his path, women in front
from whose feet the forms of the Self came near
this moving and unmoving by feet
like wind on a lotus bud
like waters on a lotus bud
lotus, white lotus, night lotus clusters
jackfruit, fig, pipal, plaksha, banyan, asafoetida
fell on the lap of earth
men and women drank with eyes
asked what else he wished to do
(they) asked, like the sky, the interior
milk, character, age, form, calf, equipment and wealth
in the water of the ocean
attacked by those born of the ocean
water mixed with milk, honey, sugarcane juice
nourishment by another, though not lean, because of superimposition
respect for others' wives and wealth
obtained by grace of the supreme deity, by recollection of the Self
suppression of the enemy side, still
supreme teachers, delighting in the Self
supreme exceedingly mighty slayer of Vritra
the supreme, endless, of unfathomable depth
abode of supreme auspiciousness, multitude of qualities
supremely valorous, with trembling shoulders, sprouts and branches
of the Supreme Self, ungraspable too
realisation of the Supreme Self, by compassion for the self-possessed for grace
the sage the supreme from the lord of yoga
the one whose mind was plunged in the depths of supreme joy
the supremely powerful activity of the Lord
of those who attained the supreme
the waters of the seat of Brahma, of him
consoled in succession in the blind darkness
of the stealer of others' wealth
